id.description: Stable key for the answer map

options.description: Options for the user to choose from (2-6 recommended)

multiSelect.description: Allow selecting multiple options. Default: false

questions.description: One or more questions to ask. Presented as a horizontal pager on mobile.

allowCustom.description: Allow typing a custom answer per question. Default: true

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds. Optional. A timeout of 1 second or less stays in the foreground.

action.description: start runs a command in the background. cancel stops a job. Neither is a status poll.

command.description: Shell command to run in the background. Required for start.

timeout.description: Kill the job after this many seconds. Optional. You are still woken when it ends; this does not make polling useful.

job_id.description: Job id returned by start. Required for cancel.

action.description: launch creates a child. release stops supervision and does not stop the session.

workspace.description: Workspace id or unique name. Required for launch.

model.description: Exact provider/model id. Required unless agent is a saved agent with its own default model.

worktree.description: Worktree id when the work may land.

auto_stop.description: Stop the child when it settles with nothing pending. Default true; false keeps it loaded until the idle timeout.

allow_nested.description: Let this child spawn sessions. Detached Donkey Master only.

idempotency_key.description: Stable key for one logical launch.

supervise.description: Wake this session when the child settles, needs attention, stalls, or the wait fails. Waiting does not send acknowledgment turns. Default true.

title.description: The outcome in a few words; the notification's headline

body.description: One or two sentences: what to read and where

path.description: Directory or file to search (default: current directory)

glob.description: Filter files by glob pattern, e.g. '*.ts' or '**/*.spec.ts'

literal.description: Treat pattern as literal string instead of regex (default: false)

context.description: Number of lines to show before and after each match (default: 0)

limit.description: Maximum number of matches to return (default: 100)
